module: "References" window (fg_references) of the Flowgraph editor: usage statistics of node types. On clicking "Load Data", it lists all node templates (core_flowgraphManager.getAvailableNodeTemplates), then counts their occurrences in all *.flow.json files of /levels/, /gameplay/ and /lua/ge/extensions/flowgraph/examples, plus in the current project (placeholder "CurrentLocalFile"). Two views: filterable list (All / Current / unused) and node detail (pins, projects that use it).
notes: Loading the data reads all of the game's flowgraph files: can be slow.
A node found in a project but without a template is classified in the 'OBSOLETE' category.
addPinsAndBehavioursForCategory reproduces the basenode logic for pins created at runtime (flow, incomplete/complete/completed, reset).

Probable bugs: draw tests `self.nodeTable == {}` (always false in Lua); updateNodeOccurrence creates the OBSOLETE branch with the literal key `filename` instead of the file name; in the f_duration case, the existence test of the 'completed' pin checks 'flow'; showNodeReferences of flowgraphEditor calls winReferences:searchFor which does not exist in this window.

C.desc: Window class (windowName 'fg_references', windowDescription 'References'). Main data: nodeTable (by node name: displayName, amount, pins {inPins,outPins}, category, behaviour, amountForProjects), nodeStatistics, filteredNodes, sortedProjects, sortedCategories, viewMode (1 list, 2 detail).

init.desc: Registers the window and initializes the tables, the view mode (1) and the filter (All).

createNodeTable.desc: Builds nodeTable from the available node templates then counts the usages (checkFilesForNodes(true)).

findNodesRecursive.desc: Recursively walks the node folder tree and creates one nodeTable entry per node (in/out pins from the pinSchema, category, behaviors) while updating the per-category statistics.

checkFilesForNodes.desc: Recomputes the occurrences of each node in the .flow.json files and in the current project, then re-filters and re-sorts.

initialCheck.desc: true at creation: does not reset the counters.

sortCategories.desc: Sorts the categories by decreasing number of node types in self.sortedCategories.

fillNodeTable.desc: Reads each flowgraph file of the list and updates the occurrences of its nodes.

updateNodeOccurrence.desc: Increments the usage counters of a node (total, per project, per category); creates an 'OBSOLETE' entry if the node is unknown.

filterNodes.desc: Builds filteredNodes according to the typed text and the filter mode (All, Current, unused), sorted by decreasing number of usages.

addPinsAndBehavioursForCategory.desc: Adds to the nodeTable entry the pins and behaviors (simple, duration, once) that are only created at runtime depending on the node's category.

pinExists.desc: Indicates whether a pin of this name already exists in the node's entry.

highlightText.desc: Writes a label, highlighting the occurrences of the searched text (copy from nodelibrary).

sortProjects.desc: Sorts the projects using the inspected node by decreasing number of occurrences in self.sortedProjects.

draw.desc: Draws the window: "Load Data" button while nodeTable is empty, otherwise navigation arrows and view 1 or 2.

drawViewMode1.desc: List view: search field, filter mode combo, statistics and node list.

drawViewMode2.desc: Detail view of the inspected node: pins and projects that use it.
